    • createAndSaveThumbnail

      @Async public CompletableFuture<ThumbnailMetadata> createAndSaveThumbnail(Path filePath, String encodedFileName, long fileId, UserDTO userDTO) throws IOException
      Description copied from interface: ThumbnailRepository
      Async function, creates and saves thumbnails to their file location and database table. Uses defaults, If there is already and thumbnail entry for a file then it replaces it by changing thumbnail file name.

      Saves thumbnails to their folders by dimensions like "horizontal" and "vertical".

      Specified by:
      createAndSaveThumbnail in interface ThumbnailRepository
      Parameters:
      filePath - File path of the file to create thumbnail of
      encodedFileName - File's BASE32 encoded file name
      fileId - File's File Metadata ID
      userDTO - General User credentials such as: ID, username and mail. Used as "alternative" for background task runners to access scope specific variables
      Returns:
      Completable future, async function thread can be awaited or its result can be ignored
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs
